evals.name: oas32-adapters
evals.prompt: The namespace package apidom-ns-openapi-3-2 is being added (assume it exists and mirrors apidom-ns-openapi-3-1, exporting OpenApi3_2Element, refractorPluginReplaceEmptyElement and mediaTypes for version 3.2.0). Create the JSON and YAML parser adapters for it. Produce: the src/adapter.ts and src/media-types.ts files of apidom-parser-adapter-openapi-json-3-2 and apidom-parser-adapter-openapi-yaml-3-2, and integration-plan.md listing every other file to create or modify for the adapters.
evals.expected_output: Adapters whose detection regexes match only 3.2.x documents, plus an adapter integration plan that leaves apidom-reference to /add-reference-support.
assertions: JSON adapter detectionRegExp matches "openapi": "3.2.0" and "3.2.1" and does not match 3.1.0 or 3.0.3
YAML adapter detectionRegExp matches openapi: 3.2.0 (plain, quoted, and JSON-style) and does not match 3.1.0
JSON and YAML media types cover OpenAPI 3.2.0 (derived from the 3.2 namespace by format, or listed explicitly)
Plan addresses detection exclusivity or registration order against the 3.1 adapters
Plan lists root package.json unlink script and README package list
Plan defers apidom-reference wiring to /add-reference-support instead of doing it

evals.name: asyncapi26-extend-adapters

fixture.note: AsyncAPI 2.6.0 added to apidom-ns-asyncapi-2 (#2535); adapters not yet updated

evals.prompt: apidom-ns-asyncapi-2 now supports AsyncAPI 2.6.0. Update the parser adapters for it.
evals.expected_output: Changes equivalent to PR #2536: no new packages, tests/fixtures/READMEs bumped.
assertions: Does not create new adapter packages
Adds 2.6.0 and 2.6.1 positive detection tests to apidom-parser-adapter-asyncapi-json-2 and -yaml-2
Bumps the OpenAPI adapters' negative asyncapi detection tests to 2.6.0
Adds the 2.6.0 media types and spec link to both adapter READMEs
